title: Function types

outcomes.can: Trace separate calls and identify which names are local.

intro: A function packages instructions so callers can use them with different values. Its parameters are names for those inputs. In hours + extra the two names refer to this call's numbers. A colon followed by number says what kind of input or output the compiler expects. return sends a value back to the caller and ends this call.

steps.title: Trace the example
steps.text: Read the inputs from left to right. Each call creates its own parameters and local variables. The name total belongs inside the braces (its scope). Another function cannot read it directly. Return it and use the returned value in the caller. A function can return a result without printing it.
